<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Mastung suicide bombing]]; [[Pakistani general election, 2018]]
**A suicide bomb attack near [[Mastung, Pakistan]], kills 129 people, including political party candidate Siraj Raisani, during a political campaign. This is the third consecutive attack on a political rally. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2018/0713/978518-pakistan-blast/ (RTÉ.ie)]
*[[International military intervention against ISIL]], [[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**[[Pakistan]], [[Iran]], [[China]], and [[Russia]] agree on joint efforts against the [[Islamic State of Iraq and Levant|Islamic State]] group in [[Afghanistan]], in an effort to ensure peace and eliminate terrorism from the region. [https://nation.com.pk/13-Jul-2018/pakistan-iran-china-russia-agree-to-carry-out-joint-efforts-against-isis (''The Nation'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*An explosion at a chemical plant near [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]], injures 12 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-44815912 (BBC)]
*An explosion at a chemical plant in [[Sichuan]], [[China]], kills 19 people and injures 12 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-44816715 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Special Counsel investigation (2017–present)]]
**Twelve [[Russia]]n intelligence officers are indicted for hacks in connection with hacking of the [[Democratic National Committee]], the [[Hillary Clinton presidential campaign, 2016|Hillary Clinton campaign]], and state election systems during the [[United States presidential election, 2016|2016 presidential election]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/07/13/628773789/deputy-attorney-general-rod-rosenstein-unveils-new-hacking-charges-in-dnc-case (NPR)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/mueller-charges-russian-intelligence-officers-hacking-dnc-clinton-n891236 (NBC News)]
